stages.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: one seamless macro albedo texture for the desert ground in SIGNAL / 47, viewed by a game camera 126–650 metres above it.
Create a square 2048×2048 image, filling the entire canvas. True vertical orthographic top-down aerial view of a natural high desert plain near Roswell, New Mexico, in April. Scale is one output pixel per metre: the square represents approximately 2×2 kilometres, not a close-up gravel surface. This must be a repeatable material tile in BOTH horizontal and vertical directions, with matching opposite edges and landforms that continue naturally across them.
Muted light yellow-brown and reddish-brown sandy soil, small irregular caliche patches, patchy short dry grass in grey brown and pale dull green. Scattered tiny creosote and mesquite dots only 1–4 output pixels wide, unevenly distributed, denser in shallow drainages and sparse on flats. One or two very shallow dry sandy washes, approximately 4–10 pixels wide, with subtly denser dark shrub dots along them. Let the washes cross the boundaries and continue at corresponding locations on opposite sides without discontinuity. Keep their bends gentle and visually unobtrusive. Add faint meandering animal trails and a few small bare wind-scoured spots. Plenty of fine local variation, no large standout patches or memorable isolated meander bigger than about 300 metres. No focal point; modest distributed terrain variation, natural asymmetry within a periodic tile.
Lighting is perfectly flat diffuse overcast, an unlit albedo image: no directional shadows, relief shading, vignette or horizon. Low to moderate contrast. Strict overall palette: mean sRGB close to RGB 164,145,123, within ten values per channel. Dark shrub values should stay around 60 or lighter; light caliche no brighter than approximately 225. Avoid white highlights and black shadows. Quiet dusty grey-brown colours rather than saturated orange or green.
No roads, tire tracks, fences, buildings, vehicles, water, snow, text, map symbols, grid, border or north arrow. No perspective, mountains, cliffs, large boulders or cloud shadows. Original fictional landscape texture, not an identifiable real satellite image. One tile, not a contact sheet.
stages.disposition: Avvist: middelfarge for mørk; senere søm-/skalareview.
